purpose: computational runtime, memory, and scalability audit
execution: sequential method-by-axis subprocess batches; no concurrent timing jobs

dimension_axis.quantity: feature dimension p; all methods use the same p-feature input for computational scaling

timing: time.perf_counter; Python imports, synthetic data generation, and common warmup excluded; method components timed separately
memory: incremental peak resident-set size sampled every 3 ms; only first observation in each isolated method-axis subprocess is interpreted as fresh-process memory reference
threading: OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS/NumExpr requested at one thread; batches executed sequentially to avoid CPU contention
